title: Woonsatisfactie in nieuwbouwwijken 1977-1981
authors: Nozeman, E.F., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Planologisch demografisch instituut (primary investigator)
descriptions: Evaluation of the extent to which behaviour and characteristics of inhabitants of new building sites match desires expressed in government policy. Moving motives, alternatives considered, future plans / commuting / shopping behaviour, means of transportation, distance travelled / reasons for settling at specific site / attractive versus non-attractive aspects of house and building site ( quarter ) / detailed household data regarding work, means of transportation, travelling distances, car ownership and use etc. / satisfaction with residence. Background variables: basic characteristics/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ consumption of durables
